summary: Confirmed for 5–13 December 2026 at TCDC Chiang Mai, SCENTS ASIA is a fragrance and wellness trade fair within Chiang Mai Design Week. The official programme combines product showcases, exhibitions, talks, workshops and awards. It is a worthwhile specialist stop for fragrance lovers, but individual visitor arrangements remain incomplete.
whyGo: Explore Thai and Asian perfume, body care, home fragrance and herbal-product businesses in one place.
The festival announcement promises an Asia Scent Showcase with more than 50 local brands, an immersive Balance in Balance exhibition and perfumery awards involving French expertise.
bestFor: Fragrance enthusiasts and shoppers seeking locally rooted products.
Design and wellness visitors interested in ingredients, packaging and creative businesses.
skipIf: Strong fragrances make enclosed exhibitions uncomfortable.
You need a guaranteed English-language workshop or a fully published timetable before committing.
duration: Allow 1–2 hours for browsing; add time for a scheduled talk or workshop. This is a planning estimate.
cost: Visitor admission and workshop prices were not stated in the official announcement checked. Budget separately for purchases and transport; do not assume every session is free.
hours: Official event announcement: 10:00–20:00 daily, 5–13 December 2026. Individual sessions may have narrower hours.
bestTime: Choose a weekday morning for a flexible browsing visit; this is a crowd-avoidance suggestion, not a published quiet period. Prioritise the date of any desired talk once schedules appear.
gettingThere: Use TCDC Chiang Mai as your taxi or ride-hailing destination. The organiser lists 1/1 Muang Samut Road, Chang Moi. Combine the visit with nearby Design Week activities after checking their separate locations.
booking: No visitor booking process was confirmed. The linked open-call form is for vendors, not admission. Recheck the official festival guide and Scents Asia social channels before departure for session registration.
accessibility: Step-free routes, lifts, accessible toilets and seating arrangements for this event are unconfirmed. Verify specific needs with the venue before choosing a workshop; fragrance exposure is intrinsic to the theme.
practicalTips: Keep this as a flexible half-day stop until the session list is published.
Ask permission before applying testers; avoid layering many scents immediately if comparing products.
Confirm the language and duration of talks before reserving a fixed slot.
decemberNotes: The 2026 year is explicitly confirmed, including Thai year 2569; this is not a recycled 2025 listing. It only fits trips overlapping 5–13 December. Vendor selection is scheduled for 30 October, so the final brand mix may become clearer after this research date.
uncertainties: Admission charges, visitor registration, workshop availability and language remain unconfirmed.
Final exhibitors, detailed session times and event-specific accessibility information were not established.
